notes.title: First update!!
notes.notes:
[b]More Maps!![/b]
Before the update, there was only one  maps total, but I added two more maps in the game.



[b]More Particles!![/b]
There are 9 particles in total, you can get them by finishing the map, or finding easter eggs.
